thread:
mara: Heads-up: finance reported a tiny but persistent mismatch in hourly preview vs ledger for EU tenants (~0.25%-0.6%). Preliminary trace points to odd epoch flips + duplicated fanout traces.

diego: Can you paste an example?

mara: Sure. Found a session where the same request_id shows up twice with different ingest_epoch and different route_resolution_id. Snip:```
2024-05-12T11:02:01Z ingest[pid=11] INFO epoch=312 tenant=tenant:sol session=sess-A req=req-7f2 route=slot-8 tokens=32
2024-05-12T11:02:04Z ingest[pid=19] INFO epoch=311 tenant=tenant:sol session=sess-A req=req-7f2 route=slot-8-fb tokens=32
```

omar: That looks like a leader flip (epoch) plus a fallback fanout emitting a mirror. If both copies are marked billable, previews will double-count until dedupe catches up.

sylvie: We purposely avoid heavy enrichment in the preview sampler to keep latency low, so dedupe keys can differ (route suffix, epoch). Two short ideas: 1) stronger canonical_request_id propagation through fanout, 2) temporary preview-side tolerance for minor epoch deltas when grouping.

diego: Quick telemetry we can add: a heatmap card for `preview_request_variants_total` broken down by (tenant, request_id_variants) and a PromQL to surface sessions seen in >1 epoch: `count by (tenant) (increase(preview_events_total{epoch_delta!=\"0\"}[1h]))`.

billing-bot: alert: preview-epoch-fanout-drift pct_tenants=0.4% severity=low (pager off)

mara: For immediate mitigation: I propose preview agg accept a fallback key ordering: canonical_request_id > request_id (stripped-suffix) > request_id+epoch windowing (epoch_delta <= 1). We can gate the epoch-tolerance behind an ops toggle for 48h.

omar: Risk: if we widen grouping by epoch, we might incorrectly merge events from real restarts. Keep it limited and logged. Also add a metric `epoch_tolerance_merges_total` to track merges done via the hotfix.

sylvie: I'll open a small patch to the preview aggregator to prefer canonical_request_id and fallback to a normalized request_id (strip `-fb|-mirror|-proxy` suffixes). Should be quick.

diego: I'll add the dashboard card and an early-warning alert: tenant-level `multi_epoch_session_rate > 0.15%` over 1h to #billing-ops.

mara: Action list: 1) aggregator hotfix (sylvie, 2h) - prefer canonical ID, strip known suffixes, epoch-delta tolerance via toggle. 2) dashboard + alert (diego, 45m). 3) enable debug sampling for affected tenants for 24h (mara, now). 4) infra: revert the epoch lease TTL change from last deploy or add leader-change quiesce (omar + infra, next sprint). 5) longer-term: make mirrors non-billable or tag them so billing ignores them (team RFC).

ingest-bot: deploy #preview-agg v1.2 candidate built at 2024-05-12T11:20Z

billing-bot: scheduled run: finance-sample-dump tenant=tenant:sol expires=2024-05-13T11:20Z link=https://s3.redwood/preview-dumps/1726002468

sylvie: PR up: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/4372 - includes normalization and an ops toggle for epoch_tolerance. Running canary in eu-west.

diego: Card added: Billing Preview -> 'multi-epoch sessions (heatmap)'. Alert wired to low-severity slack.

omar: After hotfix, let's run a compare job: replay sampled events through the new aggregator vs old to estimate how many merges we did and whether any valid distinct events were collapsed. We should log `merge_decision` reasons for 24h.

mara: Good call. I'll coordinate the compare and send results to finance. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
